question: Does the specific prior evidence cited around RAW IDEA000885 independently establish spelling or source-layer changes within a hand?
answer: No. These primaries describe local surface-form clustering, but their same-card spelling interpretation already assumes identical card meanings. They cannot independently supply the orthographic-equivalence premise for a new source-state model.

existing_raw.retained_question: A source inferred from one independently specified convention channel could predict a second entry-construction channel when the same bundle returns in nonadjacent blocks.
existing_raw.status_limit: Retain the existing raw question. Neither selecting it nor claiming that its exact proposed test has run follows from this review. No new card is needed.

claim_bearing_primaries.observed_reported_fact: Uniform page-level replacement of ol by qol and checthy by shcthy both introduces old errors; the report describes local occurrence clusters below page level.
claim_bearing_primaries.interpretation_dependency: Its renderer begins with one exact-card identity and value. The later claim that the alternatives are readable spellings of the same card, or can reflect copied blocks/exemplars, is not independently established by that renderer fit.
claim_bearing_primaries.not_claimed_here: No verification of native form identities, hand attribution, chronology, word meanings or copyist intention was performed.

claim_bearing_primaries.observed_reported_fact: The report describes initial-frame co-occurrence across its inherited fields, including one cluster of several s/sh-framed forms.
claim_bearing_primaries.interpretation_dependency: Its field, card and closure semantics are inherited assumptions. CH/D/O/Q/S meanings are assigned working readings. Mixed fields cause the mode to be optional, and a within-field restart is allowed.
claim_bearing_primaries.decision: Do not cite this as independently identified orthographic equivalence, source identity, or a mandatory field-wide agreement rule. Rebuilding the old renderer with extra states would not answer the raw source-layer question.

native_counterobligations.fact: The same physical f75v.44 line has definite qol chedy and exact joined qolchedy in ZL and IT. This already contradicts a uniform page/hand-only joining convention. It does not distinguish content, contextual spelling or exemplar change.

ZL/IT f108v.35 and .52 preserve chey versus chedy between the same full immediate neighbors. The declared deterministic local-input rule fails; farther context, optional spelling, distinct words and different parses remain open. No RF exact replication or semantic inference is added.

related_native_question_not_selected.positive: GDT850 plus GDT852 preserve a real same-line joined/split contrast. This is stronger than a spelling identity assumed by a renderer.
related_native_question_not_selected.retained_limit: The proposed assertion-versus-restricted-class reading does not yet provide the same written continuation for its later compounds. No values for ol, qol, chedy or qokar are adopted here.

already_closed_nearby_tests.scope: Zero pairs under the complete held metadata contract; no predictor scored. This is not evidence that spacing lacks information and does not close every spacing question.
The literal short/long context-substitution route has an existing NO_RECURRENT_SHORT_LONG_RULE decision; its recorded successors 927,928,983,1031 and1170 are not new next steps.
No visible repair at available resolution. Reopening the same image question is not selected.

repeat_context_qualification.decision: NO_RETAINED_CONTEXT_SIGNAL under its exact-word/leaf/position-conditioned form-similarity comparison.
repeat_context_qualification.limit: This is not a universal proof against every specific repeated-word consequence. Deriving a new chey/chedy selector solely from the already exposed1204 witness would be a post hoc single-example rule, not an independently motivated new test.

bounded_selection_conclusion.decision_change: Remove these old renderer assertions as independent positive support for a spelling/source-seam hypothesis. Preserve the raw hypothesis and the genuine native contrasts separately. Do not spend another test on unchanged spacing, short/long or repetition comparisons.
bounded_selection_conclusion.future_outcome_difference: A genuinely independently specified recurring convention bundle predicting a separate construction channel would support developing a source-layer model; failure would leave local/topic/optional alternatives. Current priors do not supply that independent convention premise, so no additional missing-input census or state fit is proposed.
bounded_selection_conclusion.scope: This is a targeted correction of the evidential basis of one existing card, not proof that all raw ideas are exhausted or all local variation is lexical.

access_and_ownership.reviewed: Live route, relevant context topic, bounded registry searches, lookup followups and targeted existing reports.
access_and_ownership.root_outputs: No current root experiment artifacts were inspected. This is not a blinded result.
